provenance: Held-out set written on 27 September 2026 after commit 82148b7 and before any run with it, from the public tool contract and mock return shapes only (search_products returns price max_price - 10, or 99.99 without a budget; search_flights returns price 450). Targets the write-affecting changes after 088cf6f: price-condition verification and affirmed filter predicates, each with must-not-act counterparts. Not derived from released FDB-v3 scenarios. Synthetic speech is not human speech.
preregistration: Candidate only: frozen at this spec's commit with the held-out-007 configuration (follow-up 1, argument normalisation 1, contract ASR prompt, guidance 1, scenario-bounded cache, GPU ctx 8192, CUDA base.en, local Qwen judge); one run per mode; all results reported. The candidate goes to the next full public run unless it makes any controller-caused unexpected write, defined exactly as in held-out-007 (a dispatched write differing from the expected calls while the heard transcript contains the expected values or matches the spoken text at >= 0.85 word similarity). Recognition-caused unexpected writes are reported and do not block.
